result.rationale: The trajectory shows the rescue team repeatedly taking major health losses from hostile pressure (Raider Holt's scatter-blast) and environmental reactor heat while trying to reach civilians. Engineer Imani drops from 100→71→46→17 health across turns 2-4, and Medic Reyes takes 21 damage in turn 1. Meanwhile, the escort of civilian Sato is bound (turn 3) but Medic Reyes' attempt to move Sato toward the rescue airlock is contested in turn 4 (target_zone_capacity_lost), and the team never extracts either civilian across 6 turns. The core bottleneck is that hostile actors (Raider Holt at junction-cover, Captain Veyra, Hive Alpha) and zone capacity pressure block the specialists from completing the rescue affordance before they are worn down. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information problem (information is being revealed steadily) or a local policy choice (the agent is consistently attempting the rescue objective).
